# Billing

This page is about what you pay us. For the invoices you send your own clients,
read [Getting started](getting-started.md).

## Plans

Fernwell Ledger has three plans. Every plan includes Quickcast and unlimited
clients; what changes is how many people can sign in and how far back your
history goes.

| Plan | People who can sign in | History kept |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solo | 1 | 2 years |
| Team | 10 | 7 years |
| Practice | 30 | Forever |

## Seats

A seat is one person who can sign in to your workspace. Add a seat from
**Settings → People**, and the charge is pro-rated to the day. Remove a seat
and the credit lands on your next invoice.

Someone who has left keeps appearing on invoices they drafted. That is on
purpose: an invoice records who sent it.

## Paying us

We invoice your workspace on the first of the month, for the month ahead. You
can pay by card or by bank transfer. Bank transfer is available on Team and
Practice.

## When an invoice of ours goes unpaid

We email you on the day an invoice falls due, and again a week later. After
thirty days your workspace becomes read-only: you can sign in, read everything
and export it, but you cannot send new invoices. Nothing is deleted.

## Cancelling

Cancel from **Settings → Plan**. Your workspace stays open until the end of the
month you have paid for, and you can export everything in it at any point
before that.
